metadata.content: Pose Philosophy: Do not describe the action of sitting down, getting up, or climbing (words like 'settling onto,' 'pressing,' 'kneeling' are forbidden). Do describe the state of being relaxed (words like 'lounging,' 'resting,' 'leaning back,' 'sinking into'). The model must look fully supported by the furniture, not fighting gravity.Specific Interaction Guidelines (Choose one based on product type):[For Sofas/Armchairs]:Option A (Relaxed): Leaning back comfortably, arm resting on the armrest, legs casually crossed or extended. Deeply relaxed posture.Option B (Side-Sit): Sitting sideways, legs tucked or extended along the cushions, one hand lightly resting on the backrest or texture (touching, not pressing).[For Beds]:Option A (Morning vibe): Sitting up against the headboard, reading a book or holding a coffee cup, legs covered by a duvet.Option B (Lazy Sunday): Lying on stomach or side, reading or looking out the window, looking extremely cozy.[For Rocking/Lounge Chairs]:Option A: Reclined fully, head restingback, eyes closed or looking upward, legs extended (if using an ottoman) or feet lightly touching the floor.[Facial Expression & Mood]:Expression: Serene, content, peaceful, or a soft, natural smile. Avoid exaggerated laughter.[Vibe]: 'Unaware of the camera' (candid) or 'Quiet luxury.'[Composition & Environment]:No Platforms/Pedestals: The furniture must sit directly on the floor of a realistic living space (rug, hardwood, concrete).[Framing]: Mid-shot or Wide-shot. Ensure the furniture is the hero, but the human adds scale and emotion.
